title: Mar Vista Recreation Center – Park Improvements (PRJ21974) Project –
text:
Mar Vista Recreation Center – Park Improvements (PRJ21974) Project –
  Commitment of Park Fees – Categorically Exempt from the Provisions of the
  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Pursuant to Article 19, Section
  15301(c) [Minor Alterations to Existing Highways and Streets, Sidewalks,
  Gutters, Bicycle and Pedestrian Trails, and Similar Facilities], Section 15301(d)
  [Restoration or Rehabilitation of Deteriorated or Damaged Structures, Facilities,
  or Mechanical Equipment to Meet Current Standards of Public Health and
  Safety], Section 15301(f) [Addition of Safety or Health Protection Devices for use
  During Construction of or in Conjunction with Existing Structures, Facilities, or

  Mechanical Equipment, or Topographical Features], Section 15302
  [Replacement or Reconstruction of Existing Structures and Facilities where the
  New Structure will be Located on the Same Site as the Structure Replaced and
  have Substantially the Same Purpose and Capacity as the Structure Replaced],
  and Section 15304(a) [Grading on Land with a Slope of Less Than 10 Percent]
  of California CEQA Guidelines and Article III, Section 1, Class 1(1), Class 1(3),
  Class 1(6), Class 2, and Class 4(1) of City CEQA Guidelines
